description.value: West Coast Poké is a Vancouver poke bowl restaurant on West 8th Avenue built around chef-inspired flavours, fresh ingredients, and sustainable sourcing. It offers both signature classic bowls (featuring Ahi tuna, Atlantic salmon, prawn, and albacore tuna) and a fully customizable build-your-own option with a wide range of proteins, toppings, and house sauces. The emphasis on an on-the-go, nourishing meal format makes it a practical and appealing fuel stop for touring cyclists.
